title: Open Worktime accepted observation
description: Public observation after intake validation and server receipt metadata are attached.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned report identifier for accepted community reports, or a local-only opaque identifier in the prototype.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the reported work.

subdivision_code.description: Optional coarse ISO 3166-2 first-level work region. This enables regional comparison without publishing a precise worker location.

facility_id.description: Canonical Open Worktime facility identifier when the site can be resolved to the facility catalog.

facility_text.description: Fallback site name supplied by the contributor when no canonical facility is available. Must not contain personal names, employee IDs, phone numbers, or email addresses.

weekly_hours_bucket.description: Half-open buckets: 35_40 means 35 <= hours < 40; gte_75 means 75 hours or more.

period_basis.description: The contributor reports their average actual weekly working time over the last four complete weeks.

submitted_at.description: Server receipt time for community reports. The client must not be trusted to set publication freshness.
